title: The Forbidden Companion of the Devourer
summary: A guarded companion for the practiced devourer that adds the heavy soul gorge and a famine that spreads through a whole group.

title: A Treatise on the Long Drain
summary: A treatise on feeding slowly from a soul over many breaths and on purging the residue of such feeding from an ally.

title: The Twin-Court Hidden Feast
summary: A hidden text of the Azure Sky schools in which two mouths feed at once from two souls and are never named in the open.

title: The Hawk's Silent Gorge
summary: A hidden text of the hawk that stoops without a sound on a soul and gorges before the foe knows he is touched.

title: The Wind-Sworn Tithe Reckoning
summary: A Gale reckoning of the tithe that the oath-sworn take from a soul and of the vow that keeps the taking measured.

title: Oath of the Unfilled Hunger
summary: A Gale oath of a hunger that is never filled and a vow to feed it only on those who have earned the taking.
